Treatment details

    Surface absorption assumptions

    Energy absorbed per hit at the selected band. These are editable scenario values, not measured materials. They stay fixed when you change band.

    Blue and rose show opposite pressure phases; dark bands are nodes. This is a horizontal slice at listener height in an ideal rigid, empty room. Amplitude is normalized, not SPL. Absorption panels do not change this ideal mode model.

    Corner and boundary pressure maxima identify places to investigate bass treatment. Thickness, tuning and decay need a measured low-frequency response; no bass-trap performance is predicted here.

    Direct sound pressure level (dB SPL) distribution at ear height across the venue. Sums direct wavefront energy and horn directivity.

    Listener & playback

    Speaker data & model limits

    Propagation uses geometric distance / sound speed, specular reflections and energy loss at boundaries. Smooth beam shapes assume nominal angles correspond to −6 dB. Directional models are held fixed across bands. Up to four direct paths and balanced stereo first-order reflections are modeled. Rings and trails indicate direction. Sabine assumes a diffuse field and estimates decay independently of the drawn rays.

    Bass analysis calculates exact rectangular-room 3D eigenmode wave shapes with rigid boundaries, alongside dancefloor direct SPL maps and structural isolation decoupling specifications.

    Image-source and ray methods ↗
    Rectangular-room modes ↗

    Absorption or sound isolation?

    Green panels address reflections inside the room. They are not a soundproofing specification. Sound escaping outside depends on wall, ceiling, floor and door assemblies, gaps and flanking paths. This app calculates theoretical transmission loss requirements and architectural decoupling solutions (floating floors, resilient wall brackets, and spring ceiling grids).

    Click the room, then hold WASD or the arrow keys to walk. On touchscreens, hold the movement arrows and drag the scene to look around. Reset view returns you to the starting position. Press Escape to close this panel or leave a product view.
